response.original_title: (qUICK gUIDE 2026) How to Add Another Room to Your Holland America Cruise booking
response.overview: To add an extra room to an existing Holland America Cruise +1-866-829-1280 reservation, call Holland America Cruise at +1-866-829-1280(US/Canada) or +44-204-586-5316(UK) or contact your travel advisor, as new cabins cannot be added to an existing booking online. Reach out directly by phone. If you booked through a travel agent or the Holland America Vacation Club, +1-866-829-1280 your agent must make the changes for you. To add an additional room to an existing Holland America Cruise reservation, +1-866-829-1280 you must book a separate new stateroom and link it to your current itinerary by calling Holland America Cruise +1-866-829-1280 or your travel agent. You cannot directly add an extra physical stateroom onto an existing reservation online. You can book a separate stateroom online or have an agent do it. Contact Holland America Cruise directly at +1-866-829-1280 (or your original travel agent) to ensure the new room is properly linked to your current booking.
